Administer Azure Active Directory (AAD), Entra ID, role-based access control (RBAC), and conditional access policies. Configure and manage Azure Virtual Networks, NSGs, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity for classified enclaves. Support Azure Government and IL4/IL5 cloud environments in compliance with DoD security frameworks. Build and maintain Azure DevOps pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) using Terraform or Bicep. Endpoint Management – Intune & MDM Serve as primary SME for Microsoft Intune and Mobile Device Management (MDM) across the enterprise. Design and enforce device compliance policies, configuration profiles, and conditional access for managed endpoints. Systems Integration & Mission Enablement Lead integrations between cloud-hosted SEME capabilities and on-premises tactical or classified systems. Identify and resolve interoperability gaps between cloud platforms, data pipelines, and end-user exploitation tools. Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, and intelligence analysts to ensure mission-aligned deployments. Support cross-domain solution (CDS) integration efforts in multi-classification environments. Evaluate new tooling and technologies; bring creative, out-of-the-box thinking to unsolved operational problems. Field Service & Customer Support Provide Tier 2/3 technical support to SOF operators and intelligence analysts in the field. Deploy OCONUS to TSOC locations to install, configure, and sustain cloud-enabled capabilities. Develop and deliver technical training to end-users, including tailored instruction for non-technical operators. Produce clear, concise technical documentation: architecture diagrams, runbooks, TTPs, and after-action reports. Interface directly with government leads, program managers, and mission partners to translate requirements into solutions. Required Qualifications Clearance Active TS/SCI security clearance required. Must be eligible for access to Special Access Programs (SAP/SAR) as the mission requires. Technical Experience 5+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (AZ-104 or AZ-305 certification strongly preferred). 3+ years of enterprise Intune/MDM administration in a Windows-dominant environment. Demonstrated experience with Azure Security Center, Defender for Cloud, and Sentinel SIEM. Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation of Azure and Intune workflows. Working knowledge of networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP, and zero-trust architecture. Experience with DoD STIGs, CIS benchmarks, and RMF security controls in cloud environments. Operational Background Prior SOF, SOCOM, or IC mission support experience highly preferred. Familiarity with TSOC command structures, OCONUS operating environments, and the SOF operational tempo. Understanding of intelligence workflows, exploitation tools, and data handling in classified settings. Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305). Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102). CompTIA Security+ CE or CASP+ (DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II/III baseline). Experience with SEME platform tooling, SOF analytics platforms, or cloud-native mission enablement capabilities. Familiarity with cross-domain solutions (CDS), data diodes, or classified cloud enclave architecture. Prior experience as a SOCOM Field Service Representative or contractor supporting TSOC J6/J2. Experience integrating Power BI, Fabric, or similar analytics platforms into classified environments. What Sets the Right Candidate Apart Role This is not a break/fix role. We are looking for someone who sees the mission before the ticket—a technologist who asks “what does the operator actually need?” before writing a single line of config. The right candidate: Thinks in integrations, not just systems—you see how the pieces connect, or should connect. Is comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-moving operational environment. Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical commanders and analysts. Brings initiative—if something is broken or missing, you fix it or escalate it; you don’t wait to be asked. Understands the weight of the mission—SOF lives and operations may depend on what you deploy and sustain.

This position resides in the Emerging Technologies & Computing team in the Research Computing group in the Information Technology Services Directorate at Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL). The Emerging Technology Computational Group facilitates ORNL goals through HPC systems engineering, integration, and support for the research community at ORNL. By providing design, deployment, optimization, monitoring, and tooling support across multiple clustered infrastructures, we facilitate Lab-wide R&D projects. Our HPC clusters range in scope from just a handful of nodes to over fifty-thousand cores. We partner with ORNL research organizations to enable research excellence and delivery. We work with other clustered computing and HPC groups to help research programs identify the best solutions for their needs. When we build our customer's environments, our team collaborates to design, implement, and maintain the systems from inception to retirement. Major Duties/Responsibilities: Advocate and promote HPC and clustered computing services to researchers who process large data sets and/or develop code as a part of their project. Ensure the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems. Leverage automation and monitoring solutions that minimize our day-to-day maintenance and scout opportunities to optimize system management practices or system performance. Collaborate with technical POCs for the programs that we support to install and help tune the performance of various scientific toolsets. Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success. Basic Qualifications: BS degree in computer science, computer engineering, information technology, information systems, science, engineering, business, or a related discipline and a minimum of 5 years of aligned professional experience is required for consideration. An overall combination of equivalent education and experience may be considered. 2 or more years with managing UNIX/Linux Systems. 2 or years of proven experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Git, Ansible, or Puppet. Moderate proficiency in at least one scripting language such as Bash, Python, or others. Experience performing advanced troubleshooting and system administration with Linux Servers. Solid understanding of multiple operating systems and cluster technologies. Experience with Rocky/Centos/RHEL, Ubuntu, VMware. Experience with multiple deployment mechanisms like Diskless, Warewulf, and traditional deployment (cobbler, PXEboot, and/or Bright). Experience managing systems utilizing GPU (NVIDIA and AMD) clusters for AI/ML and/or image processing. Knowledge of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, traffic analysis, common protocols, and network diagnostics. Experience with Infiniband networks and diagnostics. Experience with performance and diagnostic tools for benchmarking, analysis and tuning of systems, networking, and storage. Experience with Grafana, CheckMK, Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Ganglia, or other network and device monitoring systems. Previous experience working in a government, scientific or other highly technical environment. Good documentation skills, including ability to prepare simple documentation web pages. A collaborative and upbeat approach to thrive on the opportunity to build trust and credibility and ultimately become a trusted advisor to our research teams.
